name: Paroli (Reverse Martingale)

claim_quotes: like with all strategies winnings are not guaranteed and this system won't make you huge amounts of profit

The Paroli system does not change the odds of the games you're playing; over a very long timeline the casino will mathematically expect to take a cut of your money, and the Reverse Martingale does not guarantee any profit or 'beat' the game mathematically

notes: BACKTESTED via strategies/discovered/paroli-reverse-martingale.yaml (multiplier x2 on win, reset after 3). 200 seeds x 5000 rounds on Red (European): EV/unit staked -2.29%, converging to the -2.70% even-money house edge. Negative-EV; 'safer than Martingale' refers to loss variance, not to edge.
